english: Learning English is a long journey, but every step counts.
chinese: 学英语是一段漫长的旅程，但每一步都算数。
soundmark: /ˈlɜːrnɪŋ ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ɪz ə lɒŋ ˈdʒɜːrni bʌt ˈevri step kaʊnts/

english: The secret to success is consistency.
chinese: 成功的秘诀是持之以恒。

english: Don't be afraid to make mistakes when speaking English.
soundmark: /dəʊnt biː əˈfreɪd tuː meɪk mɪˈsteɪks wen ˈspiːkɪŋ ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ/

english: The best way to learn is to teach others.
chinese: 最好的学习方法是教别人。
soundmark: /ðə best weɪ tuː lɜːrn ɪz tuː tiːtʃ ˈʌðərz/

grammar.label: 不定式表语
grammar.text: The way to do is to do

english: Not only did I pass CET-4, but I also got a high score.
chinese: 我不仅通过了四级，还得了高分。
soundmark: /nɒt ˈəʊnli dɪd aɪ pɑːs siː-iː-tiː fɔːr bʌt aɪ ˈɔːlsəʊ ɡɒt ə haɪ skɔːr/

english: I will keep going until I succeed.
chinese: 我会一直坚持直到成功。
soundmark: /aɪ wɪl kiːp ˈɡəʊɪŋ ʌnˈtɪl aɪ səkˈsiːd/

english: It was through hard work that he achieved his dream.
chinese: 正是通过努力他才实现了梦想。
soundmark: /ɪt wɒz θruː hɑːrd wɜːrk ðæt hiː əˈtʃiːvd hɪz driːm/

english: A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.
soundmark: /ə ˈdʒɜːrni əv ə ˈθaʊznd maɪlz bɪˈɡɪnz wɪð ə ˈsɪŋɡl step/

english: The more you learn, the more confident you become.
chinese: 你学得越多，就变得越自信。
soundmark: /ðə mɔːr juː lɜːrn ðə mɔːr ˈkɒnfɪdənt juː bɪˈkʌm/

english: I have benefited a lot from learning English.
chinese: 我从学英语中受益匪浅。
soundmark: /aɪ hæv ˈbenɪfɪtɪd ə lɒt frɒm ˈlɜːrnɪŋ ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ/

english: Never give up on your dreams.
chinese: 永远不要放弃你的梦想。
你的态度决定你的高度。

english: Congratulations! You have completed the CET-4 course!
chinese: 恭喜！你完成了大学英语四级课程！
soundmark: /kənˌɡrætʃuˈleɪʃnz juː hæv kəmˈpliːtɪd ðə siː-iː-tiː fɔːr kɔːrs/
